summary.text: Tim Briggs is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 149, having taken office on December 1, 2008, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chaired the House Judiciary Committee in the 2023-2024 session and is an attorney by training.

paragraphs.text: Briggs earned a B.A. in political science from West Chester University and a J.D. from Temple Law School.

His professional experience includes working as a political adviser to State Senator Connie Williams, State Representative Daylin Leach, Congresswoman Marjorie Margolies-Mezvinsky and Commissioner Joe Hoeffel, and as an associate attorney for Hamburg, Rubin, Mullin Maxwell and Lupin.
Briggs has been a state representative since December 1, 2008.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair or Democratic chair of the House Judiciary Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
